Personal Finance Focus

Why I Designed FinAssist This Way

Dashboard

Gives a quick financial snapshot so users can instantly see current value, liabilities, and progress toward retirement goals.

Calculators

Helps users estimate outcomes before action, reducing guesswork across NPS, PPF, and mutual fund planning.

My Data

Keeps profile, loans, investments, and monthly plans in one place so decisions are based on complete and personalized information.

Insights

Combines health score, what-if simulation, goals, tax optimizer, and AI chat to convert raw numbers into practical next steps.

Author

Introduces the builder, design intention, and direct contact path for users who want personal finance guidance.

Most Important Feature: JSON Download and Reload

The strongest trust feature in FinAssist is data ownership. Users can download their details as JSON backup and reload the same file later to restore everything quickly.

  • Protects users from accidental data loss.
  • Makes migration and re-use simple.
  • Keeps financial details in user control with no lock-in feeling.
